findings.fact: The marketing app is Next.js 15.5.19 with React 19.2.7 and Tailwind CSS 4
Relevant installed Next.js guides (node_modules/next/dist/docs/) must be read before code changes
The landing page is a single hardcoded React component; Hero roles, stats, Work, Services, Process, and Contact are literal JSX/arrays with no DB/content source
Landing sections are composed from _components: HeroFunnel, RotatingText, CountUp, ScrollServices, ScrollProcess, ScrollWork, ContactForm, ScrollReveal, Squares
RBAC exists: Role enum (ADMIN/USER/MEMBER...), requireRole(['ADMIN']) + protectedProcedure in tRPC, hasRole in lib/rbac
An authenticated dashboard already exists with sections including users, settings, documents, etc.; this is 'the system' an admin panel would live in
Backend is tRPC routers registered in root.ts + Prisma (packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma); there is NO landing-page content model yet
A storage router exists (file uploads) usable for image/asset customization
